purpose: Structure-specific access, settlement, liquidity and suitability gates for the T1 continuation queue. It explains why a research nominee cannot be converted into a usable allocation without current evidence.

current_state.reason: No named candidate has a current, source-labelled access, suitability, tax, settlement, price/NAV, spread/depth, market-status and adverse-unwind packet.

primary_policy_links.title: iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF (SGOV) product page

common_required_packet: Current legal identity, venue, securities/fund account eligibility, investor-product risk matching and any product-specific authority.
Dated gross-to-net ledger: fees, taxes, settlement dates, distribution/interest event treatment and holder-type assumptions.
Same-session market state: trading/suspension/corporate-action status, prior close, applicable limit prices, last price, bid/ask, visible depth, turnover and traded value.
For funds and REITs: NAV/IOPV/reference-value timestamp, premium/discount and creation/redemption status where applicable.
A bounded, adverse unwind test based on observable liquidity. No queue priority, full displayed-depth availability, same-day exit or normal trading through a limit/suspension event may be assumed.

A separate account-specific feasibility review for lots, minimum fees, intended participation and tax status; a scale-neutral model is insufficient for these checks and no default amount is substituted.

material_mechanics: A-share market-status, price-limit, suspension and resale constraints

additional_gates: tracking, securities lending and derivatives where material
premium/discount, spread/depth and exact same-day turnover rule

material_mechanics: do not infer generic ETF T+0
market price/NAV/reference-value and underlying duration or counterparty risks
additional_gates: verify current ETF classification and settlement
Treasury duration/DV01 or money-market repo/counterparty review
premium/discount, capacity, fee/tax and protected-liquidity comparison

material_mechanics: listing/identifier is not proof of a particular individual's access
venue, custody, clean/dirty price, accrued interest and settlement can differ
additional_gates: demonstrate lawful accessible venue and custody

material_mechanics: listing-day and subsequent price-limit rules differ from ordinary equity assumptions
project events, valuations, capital raises and shallow secondary liquidity can impair exits
additional_gates: latest project NAV and intervening events
operating KPIs, debt/refinancing/capex and manager/sponsor/tenant/offtaker exposures
free float, spread/depth, distribution classification and tax

sgov_boundary.conclusion: SGOV is not a generally onshore-available substitute for a mainland listed cash or sovereign product.

warnings: A source link must be archived and checked against then-effective rules before it is used in a T2 or T3 decision packet.
No single settlement convention, tax rule or ETF turnover rule is assumed across asset structures.
This gate matrix does not provide orders, quantities, timing, tax advice, suitability certification or an execution recommendation.
